description: This file contains socket helper functions for testing, including socket creation, binding, listening, accepting, connecting, and data transfer functions, as well as utility functions for socket address analysis and test setup.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: A wrapper class for socket operations, providing methods like IsValid, SetReuseAddress, Bind, Listen, Connect, Accept, SendTo, ReceiveFrom, and IsPending.

classes.name: ConnectedTrio
classes.description: A data structure holding three connected sockets: listen, client, and server.

classes.name: ConnectedTrioWrapped
classes.description: A wrapper class for ConnectedTrio, managing socket objects with RAII.

methods.name: GetPortNumberForTests
methods.description: Returns a port number for testing, either system-assigned or overridden.

methods.name: IsUnspecified
methods.description: Checks if a socket address is unspecified (all zeros).

methods.name: IsLocalhost
methods.description: Checks if a socket address refers to localhost.

methods.name: CreateServerTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates a TCP server socket with reuse address option.

methods.name: CreateServerTcpSocketWrapped
methods.description: Creates a TCP server socket wrapped in a Socket class.

methods.name: CreateBoundTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates and binds a TCP socket to a specified port.

methods.name: CreateBoundTcpSocketWrapped
methods.description: Creates and binds a TCP socket wrapped in a Socket class.

methods.name: CreateListeningTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates and listens on a TCP socket.

methods.name: CreateListeningTcpSocketWrapped
methods.description: Creates and listens on a TCP socket wrapped in a Socket class.

methods.name: CreateConnectingTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates and connects a TCP socket to localhost.

methods.name: CreateConnectingTcpSocketWrapped
methods.description: Creates and connects a TCP socket wrapped in a Socket class.

methods.name: AcceptBySpinning
methods.description: Accepts a socket connection by spinning until a connection is accepted or timeout.

methods.name: WriteBySpinning
methods.description: Writes data to a socket by spinning until all data is sent or timeout.

methods.name: ReadBySpinning
methods.description: Reads data from a socket by spinning until all data is received or timeout.

methods.name: Transfer
methods.description: Transfers data between sockets, handling partial sends/receives and pending errors.

methods.name: CreateAndConnect
methods.description: Creates listening and connecting sockets, then accepts the connection.

methods.name: CreateAndConnectWrapped
methods.description: Creates listening and connecting sockets wrapped in Socket classes, then accepts the connection.

methods.name: TimedWait
methods.description: Waits on a socket waiter and returns elapsed time.

methods.name: TimedWaitTimed
methods.description: Waits on a socket waiter with timeout and returns elapsed time.
